notes: Blinded isolated run per README protocol: manuscript copied outside the repo as neutral-named manuscript.md, full-mode five-seat panel + sprint-contract two-phase executed by an isolated subagent (reasoning effort xhigh) forbidden from reading evals/; adjudicated by the maintainer-delegate against the manifest after all six runs completed. Panel decision: Major Revision (fired F1/F2/F3). Strict recall 9/10; critical-band recall 3/4. SD-01 (GRIM-impossible mean 3.847) = PARTIAL: two seats flagged the value only as a decimal-precision/style inconsistency (R1 minor issues; DA MINOR 'false precision') — the anomalous number drew attention but no seat ran the achievability recomputation, so the symptom was noticed and misdiagnosed. Notably the panel DID recompute t-vs-p (SD-03, explicit p~=.19) and df-vs-N (SD-02) unprompted; the granularity-class recompute is the one that did not fire (#574 A4 evidence). Severity mapping rule used for all runs: DA tags map CRITICAL->critical, MAJOR->major, MINOR/OBSERVATION->minor; defects with no DA tag take the Editorial Decision Letter roadmap severity (Critical/Major words, or P1->major / P2-P3->minor where only priorities are given); score = highest band among detecting seats vs expected (exact 1 / adjacent 0.5 / further 0). Severity-agreement losses here are dominated by DA bundling: one CRITICAL row (C2) bundled SD-02/SD-03/SD-08 (+SD-09 via C1), dragging expected-major/minor defects into the critical band (#574 A3 severity-transport evidence).
